title: Gambit scripts component diagram
description: The Godot client's scripts: the shell that shows one screen at a time over the 3D table, the game screen, the table and its code-built pieces, the look, sounds, and the Api autoload that talks to the Worker and, in the browser, to the page bridge.

components.name: Scripts
components.responsibility: Everything in the client but the rules.

components.name: Shell and screens (main.gd)
components.responsibility: Main: the table behind everything, the top bar, toasts, and the screens home, sign-in, computer set-up, lobby, contact and history; go() switches screens and keeps a back stack. Saves the game against the computer and the signed-out history on the device (user://).

components.name: Game screen (game_screen.gd)
components.responsibility: GameScreen: one game beside the board in mode online, computer or replay: players, the timed transcript, chat, draw offers, resign, take back, rematch, looking back at a move, and replay playback.

components.name: 3D table (board3d.gd, pieces.gd)
components.responsibility: Board3D: board, lights, camera and labels, showing and animating positions, picking and dragging pieces, promotion; PieceMeshes builds the pieces from lathe profiles and a lofted knight's head.

components.name: Server and page client (api.gd)
components.responsibility: The Api autoload: who is signed in, JSON requests, sign-in and sign-out, cached profile pictures, the page bridge (title, clipboard, invitation, Stockfish), and Api.Live, the reconnecting WebSocket to an online game.

components.name: Look (ui.gd, avatar.gd)
components.responsibility: UI: the theme, fonts, colours, widget helpers and text formats; Avatar: a round profile picture with an initial until it loads.

components.name: Sounds (sfx.gd)
components.responsibility: The Sfx autoload: sounds synthesised at start-up, four voices, mute.

components.name: Page bridge
components.responsibility: window.chessBridge in the page, with Stockfish.

components.name: Chess Worker
components.responsibility: auth/, api/ and the live WebSocket.

relationships.description: The main scene's script.
A game.
The 3D table.
Autoload Api.
The look.
Autoload Sfx.
Creates a GameScreen for each game opened and follows its leave signal.
Owns the Board3D in a SubViewport; frames it for each screen and shows the start position behind lists.
Loads who is signed in; lobby, challenges, contacts, history and saving games against the computer.
Theme, widgets and avatars.
Mute switch, selection and notification sounds.
Shows positions, sets which side may move, and takes move_made and promotion_needed.
Posts actions, opens an Api.Live for an online game in play, asks Stockfish for moves.
Main.toast, Main.save_computer and Main.finish_computer.
Chess.Game for the moves, positions, SAN and result shown.
Widgets, avatars and time formats.
Chat, offer, illegal-move and result sounds.
Chess.Position, legal moves for the hints, move flags for animation.
Move, capture, select and illegal sounds.
Avatar loads pictures through Api.avatar.
HTTPRequest to api/ and auth/ (with a Bearer token on the desktop), WebSocketPeer to api/games/{id}/live.
JavaScriptBridge calls to window.chessBridge, in the browser only.
